author: Fractalius
quote:
Some games entertain you. Others impress you. And then, once in a generation, a game comes along that changes what you believe video games can be.

Ocarina of Time is one of those games.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Fractalius
quote: Rockstar has built an extraordinary world. I'm just not convinced they've built an equally extraordinary game. beneath all that money, it's still just GTA.

author: Fractalius
quote: I honestly don't understand the critics, this game is fun and any fans of the sage will enjoy!

author: Fractalius
quote: I knew the game was great when I played the demo, the final version is everything I expected!

author: Fractalius
quote: Some gameplay mechanics from Rayman Legend, this game really delivers what we expect from a Mario in 2D! I'm also amazed by the graphics. Maybe the music is a bit behind, as it's not as catchy as some of the classic Marios, but still very nice. Overall, it's a 9.5.
